title: Settlement Base and Fees Due by Recovery History — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
**Recovery Desk terms — the amount a settlement percentage applies to, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

On a deficiency under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract, the amount the settlement percentage applies to follows the recovery history in the contract's posting record: whether the contract shows a reinstatement payment, and how the vehicle last came back. The quoted amount is the amount of the most recent deficiency quote; the fees due balance is the contract's fees due balance on the settlement date.

| Recovery history | The percentage applies to | Fees due balance |
|---|---|---|
| An earlier reinstatement payment is posted and the last recovery was involuntary | the quoted amount less the fees due balance | added in full, outside the percentage |
| No reinstatement payment is posted and the vehicle came back by voluntary surrender | the quoted amount less the fees due balance | not collected |
| Any other history | the whole quoted amount | — |

### Hypothetical figures (quoted amount $5000.00, fees due $800.00, percentage 60)

| History | Settlement amount |
|---|---|
| Earlier reinstatement, involuntary recovery | 60 percent of $4200.00, that is $2520.00, plus $800.00: $3320.00 |
| No reinstatement, voluntary surrender | 60 percent of $4200.00: $2520.00 |
| No reinstatement, involuntary recovery | 60 percent of $5000.00: $3000.00 |
| Earlier reinstatement, voluntary surrender | 60 percent of $5000.00: $3000.00 |

The quote, the fees and the percentage are illustrative figures only.
